name: Swagger Petstore (v3)
description: DDD/ODS model for Swagger Petstore v3. Inventory is a projection returning a status→count map; Orders use placed|approved|delivered.

petstore_commerce.name: Petstore Commerce
petstore_commerce.description: Core pet catalog, sales, and inventory capabilities: everything that turns a listed pet into a delivered one

catalog.name: Catalog
catalog.description: Pet definitions, attributes, lifecycle. Core because the selection of pets is what customers come for

sales.name: Sales
sales.description: Orders and order lifecycle. Core because approving the right order at the right time is the store's promise

inventory.name: Inventory
inventory.description: Aggregated availability by status. Supporting: it must exist, but any correct count will do

fulfilment.name: Fulfilment
fulfilment.description: Getting a sold pet to its owner. Supporting: needed, but a courier could do it just as well

identity_&_accounts.name: Identity & Accounts
identity_&_accounts.description: Users and sessions per Petstore API; kept as its own domain because it would be bought rather than built

users.name: Users
users.description: User records and login/logout. Generic: an off-the-shelf identity provider would serve

catalog_bc.name: Catalog BC
catalog_bc.description: Owns the Pet aggregate and the pet-facing operations

pet.name: Pet
pet.description: A pet listed in the store. One aggregate because a pet's photos, tags and status change together

change_pet_status.name: ChangePetStatus
change_pet_status.description: Move a pet between available, pending and sold; the catalogue's own edits, e.g. relisting

reserve_pet.name: ReservePet
reserve_pet.description: available → pending: the pet is held for an approved order; run by PetApp on the request Sales makes

mark_pet_sold.name: MarkPetSold
mark_pet_sold.description: pending → sold: the pet has gone to its owner; run by PetApp on the request Sales makes

pet.name: Pet
pet.description: The listed animal; everything else in the aggregate hangs off it

name_required.name: NameRequired
name_required.description: Pet.name must be non-empty, because the storefront lists pets by name

sold_not_reopen.name: SoldNotReopen
sold_not_reopen.description: Once sold, a pet does not revert to available without an explicit policy, so a buyer is never undercut. Constrains the Pet because the transition is the pet's, not the status value's, and the operation that makes the transition, because that is where the rule is enforced

upload_image.name: UploadImage
upload_image.description: POST /pet/{petId}/uploadImage; adds a PhotoUrl, so it is a profile update

get_pet_summary.name: GetPetSummary
get_pet_summary.description: GET /pets/{id}/summary; asked with a PetId, answers with a PetSummary, so Sales can check availability without coupling to the full Pet

comments.text: The summary projection is the only Catalog read Sales is allowed to make.

reserve_pet_for_order.name: ReservePetForOrder
reserve_pet_for_order.description: POST /pet/{petId}/reserve; holds the pet for an approved order by running the aggregate's ReservePet

comments.text: Reservation is a synchronous call into Catalog; it should become an order-placed subscription so Sales stops blocking on Catalog.

mark_pet_sold_for_order.name: MarkPetSoldForOrder
mark_pet_sold_for_order.description: POST /pet/{petId}/sold; records the sale by running the aggregate's MarkPetSold

pet.name: Pet
pet.definition: An animal listed for sale in the store

category.name: Category
category.definition: The kind of animal a pet is, such as Dogs or Cats

available.name: Available
available.definition: A pet that can be ordered; it becomes pending when Sales approves an order for it (ReservePet) and sold when that order is delivered (MarkPetSold)

category.name: Category
category.description: The kind of animal, e.g. Dogs. A value because two pets in Dogs share one category

photo_url.name: PhotoUrl
photo_url.description: Where a photo of the pet can be fetched

pet_status.name: PetStatus
pet_status.description: Where the pet is in its sales lifecycle. Shared with Inventory, which keys its counts by these values

pet_registered.name: PetRegistered
pet_registered.description: What the outside learns when a pet joins the catalog

register_pet.name: RegisterPet
register_pet.description: Request body for adding a pet

pet_id.name: PetId
pet_id.description: Identifies one pet; shared by every consumable that only needs the id

pet.name: Pet
pet.description: The full pet resource, as GET /pet/{petId} answers with it

pet_summary.name: PetSummary
pet_summary.description: The slim read of a pet other contexts are allowed to hold

pet_unavailable.name: PetUnavailable
pet_unavailable.description: Why the pet could not be held: it is already pending or sold

sales_bc.name: Sales BC
sales_bc.description: Owns the Order aggregate and the order-facing operations

order_approved.name: OrderApproved
order_approved.description: Order approved (status=approved); Inventory and Fulfilment both react

approve_order.name: ApproveOrder
approve_order.description: Approve a placed order once the pet is available

deliver_order.name: DeliverOrder
deliver_order.description: Mark an approved order as delivered; run by OrderApp when Fulfilment reports the shipment arrived

order.name: Order
order.description: The customer's request to buy one pet

pet_id.name: petId
pet_id.description: Identity of the Pet root in Catalog; only the id crosses the boundary

one_animal_per_order.name: OneAnimalPerOrder
one_animal_per_order.description: Quantity is exactly 1: a Pet is one animal with one status, so it cannot be sold five times. The API's quantity field is accepted but never exceeds one

approve_only_when_available.name: ApproveOnlyWhenAvailable
approve_only_when_available.description: Move to approved only after the catalogue's summary reported the pet available; the catalogue's status itself is outside this aggregate, so the check is a read through the ACL, not a shared invariant

deliver_only_when_approved.name: DeliverOnlyWhenApproved
deliver_only_when_approved.description: Deliver only from approved and only once a ship date is set, so nothing is marked delivered that was never checked or never dispatched

confirm_delivery.name: ConfirmDelivery
confirm_delivery.description: POST /store/order/{orderId}/delivered; Fulfilment reports the shipment arrived and the order moves to delivered

reserve_pet.name: ReservePet
reserve_pet.description: Ask Catalog to hold the ordered pet, through the ACL; Sales' own step in the order lifecycle

mark_pet_sold.name: MarkPetSold
mark_pet_sold.description: Tell Catalog the ordered pet has gone to its owner, through the ACL

comments.text: PetSummaryClient is the translator; nothing else in Sales knows the catalog payload shape.

approve_when_pet_available.name: Approve when pet available
approve_when_pet_available.description: On OrderPlaced, or on PetStatusChanged to available, look up the placed orders for that petId, confirm availability through GetPetSummary and approve the oldest

reserve_pet_on_approval.name: Reserve pet on approval
reserve_pet_on_approval.description: When an order is approved, hold its pet (available → pending) so nobody else can be approved for the same animal

mark_pet_sold_on_delivery.name: Mark pet sold on delivery
mark_pet_sold_on_delivery.description: When an order is delivered, the pet is sold (pending → sold)

order.name: Order
order.definition: A customer's request to buy one pet; placed, then approved, then delivered

pet.name: Pet
pet.definition: Only the identity of a catalogue pet; Sales holds no pet attributes and asks the catalogue for availability

approval.name: Approval
approval.definition: Confirmation that the ordered pet is available and reserved

order_status.name: OrderStatus
order_status.description: Where the order is in its lifecycle

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: The v3 API's quantity field, kept for the wire shape. A Pet is an individual animal, so the invariant below pins it to 1

ship_date.name: ShipDate
ship_date.description: When the order ships; set by Fulfilment once dispatch is planned

place_order.name: PlaceOrder
place_order.description: Request body for placing an order

order_detail.name: OrderDetail
order_detail.description: One order, as GET /store/order/{orderId} answers with it

inventory_query.name: InventoryQuery
inventory_query.description: Open-host service for /store/inventory: a projection is a service that provides a query (decision 15), not an aggregate with an invented root

get_inventory.name: GetInventory
get_inventory.description: GET /store/inventory; takes nothing, answers with the counts

recount_inventory.name: RecountInventory
recount_inventory.description: Recompute the status→count map from catalog and sales facts

availability.name: Availability
availability.definition: How many pets are available, pending and sold right now; a projection, not a source of truth

inventory_counts.name: InventoryCounts
inventory_counts.description: How many pets stand in each status right now

fulfilment_bc.name: Fulfilment BC
fulfilment_bc.description: Plans and tracks the shipment of an approved order until it is delivered

shipment.name: Shipment
shipment.description: The journey of one approved order to its owner. Attempts live inside it because they mean nothing without the shipment

shipment_planned.name: ShipmentPlanned
shipment_planned.description: A ship date was chosen for an approved order

record_delivery_attempt.name: RecordDeliveryAttempt
record_delivery_attempt.description: Log a delivery attempt; a successful one delivers the shipment

order_id.name: orderId
order_id.description: Identity of the Order root in Sales; only the id crosses the boundary

delivery_attempt.name: DeliveryAttempt
delivery_attempt.description: A dated try at handing over the pet; an entity because attempts are counted and ordered, a child because it never exists without its shipment

delivered_only_by_attempt.name: DeliveredOnlyByAttempt
delivered_only_by_attempt.description: A shipment becomes delivered only through a successful delivery attempt, so the audit trail is never empty

carrier.name: Carrier
carrier.description: The company that carries a consignment. Its own cluster because carriers are onboarded, rated and retired on their own schedule, nothing to do with any one shipment

dispatch_planner.name: DispatchPlanner
dispatch_planner.description: Chooses ship dates across planned shipments so orders approved on the same day leave together; it only needs orderIds and dates, which is all OrderApproved gives it

plan_dispatch.name: PlanDispatch
plan_dispatch.description: Create a shipment and pick its ship date for an approved order

shipment_app.name: ShipmentApp
shipment_app.description: Fulfilment's application service: the boundary through which Fulfilment reports delivery to Sales

report_delivery.name: ReportDelivery
report_delivery.description: Tell Sales the shipment arrived, by calling the order's ConfirmDelivery

plan_dispatch_on_approval.name: Plan dispatch on approval
plan_dispatch_on_approval.description: Every approved order gets a shipment planned straight away

deliver_order_on_delivery.name: Deliver order on delivery
deliver_order_on_delivery.description: When a shipment is delivered, report it to Sales so the order moves to delivered

shipment.name: Shipment
shipment.definition: The consignment that carries one order to its owner

tracking_number.name: TrackingNumber
tracking_number.description: Carrier reference; a value because two shipments never share one

identity_bc.name: Identity BC
identity_bc.description: Owns User aggregate & user endpoints. Legacy: user status is an untyped int and login is a GET

user.name: User
user.description: Petstore user record, as the legacy API shapes it

user.name: User
user.description: A registered user of the store

login.name: Login
login.description: GET /user/login?username=&password= (a GET with credentials: legacy, recorded not endorsed)

user.name: User
user.definition: Someone with a login; orders never refer to one

user_status.name: UserStatus
user_status.description: Untyped int per the Petstore v3 model; nobody remembers the meaning of each value

user.name: User
user.description: The legacy user record, as GET /user/{username} answers with it

relationships.description: Sales needs pet availability; Catalog commits to the summary contract

comments.text: Sales reads Catalog through PetSummaryClient, which maps the catalog payload onto the Sales order model.
The summary contract is versioned and published; Catalog will not break it without a major release.

relationships.description: The projection counts orders as Sales reports them

comments.text: The projection conforms to the Sales order events rather than translating them; accepted while Inventory stays read-only.

relationships.description: PetStatus and its values are one shared definition

comments.text: PetStatus and its values live in @petstore/kernel and both services compile against it.
The kernel has grown past the status enum and now carries pricing rules; it should become a Published Language from Catalog.

relationships.description: Order lifecycle and shipment lifecycle are designed and released together

comments.text: Both services ship from one release train; the pipeline deploys sales and fulfilment as a pair and fails the build if only one is tagged.

OrderApproved and ShipmentDelivered cross the boundary one way each, and Fulfilment calls ConfirmDelivery on top of that, all with no translation layer; each side depending on the other is what makes this a partnership rather than customer-supplier.

relationships.description: Orders are anonymous in Petstore v3; no integration by design

comments.text: The order payload carries no user field and the Sales service holds no credentials for the Identity API, so nothing links an order to an account.
Keeping the two apart is deliberate: checkout must work for a visitor who never signs in.

pet_shop_team.name: Pet Shop Team
pet_shop_team.description: Owns the catalog and the inventory projection built from it

orders_team.name: Orders Team
orders_team.description: Owns order taking and fulfilment, so the two ship together
